remarks: Peace and Tranquility await at this lovely location situated on 2 acres. Amazing view of the grounds from the oversized windows and glass doors! Freshwater Lane is a cul de sac and the house is located away from the street. This unit has a private driveway.  ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED!!! Electric, heat, hot water, central air, water, and WIFI are all included in rent! Spacious, open floor Living Room/Kitchen on main level. Bedroom suite filled with tons of natural light is on second level and has a huge picture window overlooking the serene grounds with bathroom that has a radiant heated floor!  Near Route 7, great for commuters! Close to shopping, Cranbury park with trails and dog park is only .25 miles away! Pet friendly!
